arguments.text: Let the pack go. Settle to your own steady rhythm.

text: let_go: holding the wash takes 190 W shaft vs 149 W critical power, reserve would empty in about 1.3 km of 5.8 km left.

arguments.condition: elapsed_s >= 90 and remaining_m > 1200 and empties_in_m_pod < remaining_m - maximum(300, 0.1 * remaining_m)
arguments.message: pod reserve runs out well before the finish at this shaft power

arguments.condition: elapsed_s >= 90 and remaining_m > 1200 and shaft_power_w > 1.06 * sustainable_shaft_power_w and empties_in_m_pod < remaining_m - maximum(300, 0.1 * remaining_m)
arguments.message: shaft power more than 6 pct over sustainable: pod reserve runs out before the finish

text: no cue: paddler already eased to 162 W shaft, near the 158 W sustainable; alert came from the boat-model reserve, replaced with a pod-based watch.

arguments.text: Ease a touch, settle at 2:45 pace, long smooth strokes.

text: ease to 2:45: shaft 165 W is 6 pct over the 156 W sustainable, pod reserve 62 pct would empty 2.6 km before the finish.

arguments.text: Ease off now to 2:46 pace, save it for the finish.

text: ease to 2:46: shaft held at 165 W against 155 W sustainable for 4 min, pod reserve 41 pct empties 2.7 km early; earlier ease not taken.
no cue: paddler eased to 158 W shaft, close to the 154 W sustainable; let them settle.

arguments.text: Ease slightly to 2:50 pace, stay smooth, sprint comes later.

text: ease to 2:50: shaft 158 W over the 153 W sustainable, pod reserve 22 pct empties 1.7 km early, fade growing to -2.8 pct.
no cue: power spike is the turn, an ease cue was just given; let it take effect.

arguments.text: Too hard. Back off the effort, relax, forget the pace.
Too hard. Back off the effort, relax, forget the pace.

text: ease on effort: shaft up to 168 W chasing pace as efficiency drops, pod reserve 16 pct would empty in 460 m of 2.9 km.

arguments.text: Lengthen out, drop the rate a little, easy power.

text: rate_down: fade -4.5 pct and growing at 69 spm, pod reserve under 10 pct with shaft still above sustainable.

arguments.text: Reserve is gone. Ease to 2:52 and hold it steady.

text: ease to 2:52: shaft back up to 166 W, pod reserve 3 pct empties in about 100 m with 2.4 km left.

arguments.text: Settle down a notch to 2:53, breathe, save the sprint.

text: ease to 2:53: pod reserve empty with shaft still 162 W over 149 W critical power and fade -4.7 pct, 2.1 km left.
no cue: turn just taken and an ease cue was given seconds ago; current negligible.

arguments.message: final sprint window: about 300 m left, decide the finish cue now (pod reserve has read empty since 21 min while shaft held near 157 W without collapse)

text: no cue: shaft settled near 157 W with speed steady at 2.92 m/s; too early to sprint on an empty reserve, watch set for the last 330 m.
no cue: last turn taken, effort steady near 157 W, current negligible; sprint decision comes later.

arguments.text: Three hundred to go. Build it now, sprint to the line!

text: finish: about 300 m left, paddler held 157 W for 10 min on an empty-reading reserve without collapse, so spend what is left now.
